title: End-loaded cantilever of rectangular section with shear deformation

source.work: McGuire, W., Gallagher, R. H., Ziemian, R. D., Matrix Structural Analysis
source.notes: input data and targets read on the cited pages; nothing of the source is reproduced

analysis: Plane (x-y) problem of the source modelled in 3D with the global Y axis vertical, so that the source's x, y and theta_z are the model's X, Y and rz. In-plane bending is about local z for every member (default orientation), hence the source's I is the section's Iz. The source gives the tip deflection of an end-loaded cantilever including shear deformation as gamma P L^3 / (3 E I), with I = b d^3 / 12, shear area (2/3) b d and nu = 0.3, and prints gamma = 1.039 for d/L = 1/5 and gamma = 1.010 for d/L = 1/10. Numeric instance chosen here (the example is non-dimensional): b = 100 mm, d = 200 mm, E = 200 kN/mm^2, nu = 0.3, P = 10 kN upward at the tip; member 1 with L = 1000 mm (d/L = 1/5), member 2 with L = 2000 mm (d/L = 1/10). Section given by properties with Asy = (2/3) b d (the source's shear area); analysis with shear deformation. The target is the printed gamma times P L^3/(3 E I) of the instance. First order.

targets.precisionNote: printed "1.039" x 0.25 (unit conversion / common factor of the source); tolerance = half a unit in the last printed digit; gamma for d/L = 1/5; the factor is P L^3/(3 E I) of the instance
printed "1.010" x 2 (unit conversion / common factor of the source); tolerance = half a unit in the last printed digit; gamma for d/L = 1/10; the factor is P L^3/(3 E I) of the instance

limitsNote: The model has shear deformation: the foreign solvers of tier C cannot represent it (docs/VERIFICATION.md, Limits).
